steps.en: Vendor the monorepo — nothing is published to npm yet
steps.zh: 以源码方式引入——还没有发布到 npm

steps.en: Create persisted state with a storage key and an initial value
steps.zh: 用存储键加初始值创建要持久化的状态

steps.en: On mount, JSON-parses the stored envelope and returns it, or falls back to your initial value
steps.zh: 挂载时解析存储里的包装对象并返回，没有就落回你给的初始值

steps.en: Read and update it like any useState
steps.zh: 像普通 useState 一样读和更新

steps.en: Serializes the state back to storage on every change
steps.zh: 每次变化都把状态序列化写回存储

steps.en: On the next load, clears values whose buster or maxAge no longer matches
steps.zh: 下次读取时清掉版本不符或过期的值

value.en: State that survives reloads without hand-written parse/save plumbing — at the cost of vendoring an unpublished 0.x
value.zh: 状态刷新后还在，不用手写解析和保存的管道——代价是引入一个未发布的 0.x

sources: docs/installation.md (npm install @tanstack/react-persist — the documented install, though both packages 404 on npm at verification)
packages/react-persist/src/storage-persister/useStorageState.ts (loads persister.loadState() ?? initialValue on mount; saves on every state change)
packages/persist/src/storage-persister.ts (PersistedStorage envelope { buster, state, timestamp }, JSON.stringify/JSON.parse defaults, buster/maxAge invalidation removes the stored item)
